w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Ad Break is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Spoiler
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
firstContext: The cistern is dry. Haul from a creek (risky water), or put someone on water duty.
Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
👁️ Desmond freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
You also take some vine (crafting material).

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🪵 Elif hauls back 12 wood. The pile grows. (892 logs now.)
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
🌟 "We have detected elevated attachment to Unit FLANNEL SHIRT. This is inefficient. This is also... [PROCESSING] ...valuable? Optimization available." (Choose an enhancement for your Flannel Shirt.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/10/6), with 3 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 18 · Craft 13 · Talk 14 · Explore 25 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Aroha Ngata ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
